headline: Strong Jobs Report
detail: The US economy added significantly more jobs than expected, and unemployment fell. This could put pressure on the Fed regarding interest rate cuts, which generally impacts growth and tech stocks negatively.
rec: Monitor how your tech and chip holdings react to this economic data. No immediate action is suggested without further price confirmation.

headline: S&P 500 AI Bet
detail: The S&P 500 is heavily influenced by AI-related stocks. This highlights the concentration risk within your tech-heavy portfolio.
rec: Keep an eye on the AI narrative. If it falters, it could disproportionately impact your holdings.

headline: Moderna Outlook
detail: Moderna raised its revenue outlook, but the focus is on its experimental cancer vaccine. This is a specific biotech development, not directly tied to your core chip holdings.
rec: This headline is not directly relevant to your current concentrated tech/chip portfolio.
